# Cyberdeck builds

`cyberdeck.apk` is the latest debug build (unsigned debug key — Android Play
Protect will warn; tap "Install anyway"). Download it directly:

https://github.com/antoniosousapedro99-png/Spellbook/raw/ccr-88b5ddd2-6hcj5j/dist/cyberdeck.apk

It is refreshed as new builds are made. For reproducible builds, build from
`android-client/` with the Android SDK (`./gradlew assembleDebug`).
